Maya (CS): Hey team — Orchid Labs asked for a focused enablement week next month. Need to lock days and owners. Renewal flagged as yellow, want a smooth handoff.
Luca - CSM: Thanks Maya. They prefer mornings (UTC-5) and asked for a 2hr workshop + 1hr office hours each day.
Priya - Enablement: I can run workshops Mon/Wed (AM UTC-5). Can someone cover Tue/Thu?
Jonah - Solutions Eng: I can take Tue workshops, but Thu I’m in a regional customer deep-dive.
Maya (CS): @Priya can you draft a lean agenda? keep it product->integration->best-practices. Also capture feedback after each session.
Priya - Enablement: Drafted quick agenda below — thoughts?
```
Day 1 (2h): platform overview (20m) / auth & demo (40m) / hands-on lab (50m) / Q&A (10m)
Day 2 (2h): model routing & performance tuning (30m) / inference cost tools (30m) / lab (50m) / Q&A (10m)
Day 3 (2h): dedicated/private deployment patterns (30m) / ops/obs (40m) / migration checklist (30m) / Q&A (20m)
Office hours (1h): open queue, 15m priority block for product leads
```
Luca - CSM: Looks good. Add a 5–10min renewal check-in on Day 3 to surface any blockers.
Jonah - Solutions Eng: I'll prep a short troubleshooting checklist and a small diagnostic script to share in the lab channel.
Maya (CS): Coverage gap: Thu workshop still open. @Oncall Bot — who is scheduled for Thu morning (UTC-5) next week?
Oncall Bot: Thu morning owner: "Sam - SE" (auto-assigned).
Priya - Enablement: @Sam - SE if you can cover Thu that would close it. If not, let's swap Tue/Thu between Jonah and Sam.
Luca - CSM: Also: can we get an invite for customer success leadership to the Day 3 renewal block? I want exec presence for any negotiation signals.
Maya (CS): Good call. I'll loop in execs after agenda final.
Jonah - Solutions Eng: FYI I’ll attach the diagnostic gist after this thread and include a short runbook for common latency issues.
Priya - Enablement: Feedback capture plan: short Google form after each day + 3 quick in-session polls. I'll post form link to the pre-read.
Maya (CS): Risk note: account shows rising error rates on embeddings path — flagged by support last week. @Jonah please confirm if we should surface fix guidance in Day 2 lab.
Jonah - Solutions Eng: Confirmed — plan to include a subsection "embedding retries & cache warmup" in Day 2.
Luca - CSM: Timeline: finalize agenda by EOD Fri (1764444600), send invites Mon, pre-read 48h before Day 1. Can everyone ack?
Priya - Enablement: ack :white_check_mark:
Jonah - Solutions Eng: ack :white_check_mark:
Sam - SE: ack — will cover Thu if schedule holds :raised_hands:
Maya (CS): Great. I'll update the internal runbook and create a post-session CS feedback thread for renewal cues. Thanks team! :rocket:
